self_host: IBM Plex superfamily subsetted to Latin — served from web-canon, not Google Fonts

sans.name: IBM Plex Sans
sans.use: human voice — body, h2, h3, UI text

serif.name: IBM Plex Serif
serif.use: doctrine voice — display, h1, /laws, /arif/writings, doctrinal surfaces

mono.name: IBM Plex Mono
mono.fallback: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
mono.use: machine voice — caption, breadcrumbs, code, IDs, epistemic labels, state labels, JSON keys

human.rationale: Modern, geometric, legible — human narrative voice

machine.rationale: Structural, monospace, structural not stylistic — IDs, codes, states

scale.ratio: sqrt(2) — the octave of paper sizes (A-series fractal)

rules.mono_use_rule: structural not stylistic — IDs, breadcrumbs, state labels, epistemic labels, JSON keys. Never for entire paragraphs.
rules.epistemic_voice: IBM Plex Mono for: OBS · DER · INT · SPEC (kernel) · CLAIM · PLAUSIBLE · ESTIMATE · UNKNOWN (WEALTH briefing)

lint_rules.name: single_skeleton
lint_rules.rule: no font other than IBM Plex superfamily may be referenced in compiled CSS

lint_rules.name: self_hosted_only
lint_rules.rule: no @import or font URL pointing to Google Fonts, fonts.com, etc.
